# Total Body Physio

> Hands-on physiotherapy in Auckland, New Zealand, since 2000. Four clinics: Titirangi (West Auckland), Pakuranga, Flat Bush/Botany and Panmure (East Auckland). ACC accredited provider: no GP referral needed, ACC claims lodged at the first visit, free first ACC visit at Panmure and Flat Bush, follow-ups from $30. Book online at https://total-body-physio.au1.cliniko.com/bookings

Total Body Physio Limited is a New Zealand physiotherapy practice. It treats musculoskeletal injuries and pain (back, neck, shoulder, knee, hip, ankle, sports injuries, sciatica, headaches, work and motor vehicle injuries, post-surgery rehab, arthritis, chronic pain) with hands-on manual therapy, exercise and gym rehab, acupuncture and dry needling, hydrotherapy and therapeutic massage. Gold Card holders and students get about $5 off. Languages: English, Mandarin, Cantonese, Arabic.

## Clinics

- [Titirangi](https://www.totalbodyphysio.co.nz/titirangi.html): 2 Rangiwai Rd, Titirangi, Auckland. Phone 09 817 7377, titirangi@totalbodyphysio.co.nz. Hours: Monday 9am – 5pm; Tuesday 7am – 5pm; Wednesday 9am – 5pm; Thursday 9am – 5pm; Friday 7am – 5pm; Saturday Closed; Sunday 9am – 3pm. ACC co-pay: $45 initial · $40 follow-up. On-site gym · Therapeutic massage · Open Sundays.
- [Pakuranga](https://www.totalbodyphysio.co.nz/pakuranga.html): Lloyd Elsmore Pools, 1 Sir Lloyd Drive, Pakuranga Heights, Auckland. Phone 09 535 1932, pakuranga@totalbodyphysio.co.nz. Hours: Monday – Thursday 7am – 6pm; Friday 7am – 3pm; Saturday 8:30am – 2pm (physio); Sunday 10am – 3pm (acupuncture + physio). ACC co-pay: $35 initial · $30 follow-up. Acupuncture & dry needling · Pool & gym on-site · Open weekends.
- [Flat Bush / Botany](https://www.totalbodyphysio.co.nz/flatbush.html): 14 Fusion Rd, Flat Bush, Auckland. Phone 09 265 2323, botany@totalbodyphysio.co.nz. Hours: Monday – Friday 9am – 6pm. ACC co-pay: FREE first visit · $30 follow-up. Purpose-built clinic · Dry needling · Chinese-speaking physio.
- [Panmure](https://www.totalbodyphysio.co.nz/panmure.html): Lagoon Pools, 29 Lagoon Drive, Panmure, Auckland. Phone 09 573 5788, panmure@totalbodyphysio.co.nz. Hours: Monday – Thursday 7am – 5pm; Friday 7am – 3pm. ACC co-pay: FREE first visit · $30 follow-up. Hydrotherapy pool · Gym on-site · Free 20-min option if cost is a barrier.

## Treatments

- [ACC physio](https://www.totalbodyphysio.co.nz/acc-physio.html): how ACC works, co-payments at each clinic, no GP referral
- [Acupuncture & dry needling](https://www.totalbodyphysio.co.nz/acupuncture-dry-needling.html): $35 per 45-minute session at Pakuranga; Sunday acupuncture with a Mandarin-speaking acupuncturist
- [Hydrotherapy](https://www.totalbodyphysio.co.nz/hydrotherapy.html): pool rehab at Panmure (Lagoon Pools) and Pakuranga (Lloyd Elsmore Pools)
- [Therapeutic massage](https://www.totalbodyphysio.co.nz/massage.html): Titirangi, 60 min $100 / 45 min $80
- [Sports injury physio](https://www.totalbodyphysio.co.nz/sports-injury-physio.html): gym rehab and return-to-sport testing
- [Conditions we treat](https://www.totalbodyphysio.co.nz/conditions.html): approach and typical recovery times for 15 common conditions
